subject: post
title: (R)POST.------PRI.AF.TD.
description: Chart on book p. 387 (JR-9). POST (postulation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies) is the partner. From the subject: AEXP-DY, POL-DY (political dynamics) and SOC-RT (social reality). From AEXP-DY: RE-ST (restructuralism). From RE-ST: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From POL-DY: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From SOC-RT: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) and CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). From CULT-SOLD: RE-DOC (redocumentation).
